123 |         layersDict = {}
124 |         if layers:
125 |             layersDict = {os.path.basename(lyr.source().split(".")[0]): lyr for lyr in layers}
126 | 
127 |         crs = self.parameterAsCrs(parameters, self.CRS, context)
128 |         if not layers and not crs.isValid():
129 |             raise QgsProcessingException(self.tr("No reference layer selected nor CRS provided"))
130 | 
131 |         if not crs.isValid() and layers:
132 |             crs = list(layersDict.values())[0].crs()
133 | 
134 |         bbox = self.parameterAsExtent(parameters, self.EXTENT, context)
135 |         if not layers and bbox.isNull():
136 |             raise QgsProcessingException(self.tr("No reference layer selected nor extent box provided"))
137 | 
138 |         if not bbox.isNull():
139 |             bboxCrs = self.parameterAsExtentCrs(parameters, self.EXTENT, context)
140 |             if bboxCrs != crs:
141 |                 transform = QgsCoordinateTransform(bboxCrs, crs, context.project())
142 |                 bbox = transform.transformBoundingBox(bbox)
143 | 
144 |         if bbox.isNull() and layers:
145 |             bbox = QgsProcessingUtils.combineLayerExtents(layers, crs)
146 | 
147 |         cellsize = self.parameterAsDouble(parameters, self.CELLSIZE, context)
148 |         if not layers and cellsize == 0:
149 |             raise QgsProcessingException(self.tr("No reference layer selected nor cellsize value provided"))
150 | 
151 |         def _cellsize(layer):
152 |             ext = layer.extent()
153 |             if layer.crs() != crs:
154 |                 transform = QgsCoordinateTransform(layer.crs(), crs, context.project())
155 |                 ext = transform.transformBoundingBox(ext)
156 |             return (ext.xMaximum() - ext.xMinimum()) / layer.width()
157 |         if cellsize == 0:
158 |             cellsize = min([_cellsize(lyr) for lyr in layersDict.values()])
159 |

161 |             name = lyr.name()
162 |             if (name + "@") in expression:
163 |                 layersDict[name] = lyr
164 |

166 |         for name, lyr in layersDict.items():
167 |             for n in range(lyr.bandCount()):

171 |                     entry.ref = ref

179 |         height = math.floor((bbox.yMaximum() - bbox.yMinimum()) / cellsize)

275 |         os.makedirs(TMP_DIR, exist_ok=True)
276 |         tmp_path = os.path.join(TMP_DIR, f"{work_tag}_alpha.tif")
277 |         extent = raster_layers[0].extent()
278 |         crs = raster_layers[0].crs()
279 |         width = raster_layers[0].width()
280 |         height = raster_layers[0].height()

282 |         entries: List[QgsRasterCalculatorEntry] = []
283 |         for i, layer in enumerate(raster_layers):
284 |             ds = gdal.Open(layer.dataProvider().dataSourceUri())
285 |             alpha_bands = [
286 |                 b for b in range(1, ds.RasterCount + 1)
287 |                 if ds.GetRasterBand(b).GetColorInterpretation() == gdal.GCI_AlphaBand
288 |             ]
289 |             ds = None
290 | 
291 |             if alpha_bands:
292 |                 for b in alpha_bands:
293 |                     entry = QgsRasterCalculatorEntry()
294 |                     entry.ref = f"layer{i}_a{b}@{b}"
295 |                     entry.raster = layer
296 |                     entry.bandNumber = b
297 |                     entries.append(entry)
298 | 
299 |         if len(entries) == 0:
300 |             return None
301 |         elif len(entries) == 1:
302 |             src = entries[0].raster.source()
303 |             shutil.copyfile(src, tmp_path)
304 |             return tmp_path
305 |         else:
306 |             expr = DynamicLayerFactory.binary_unbalanced_expression([entry.ref for entry in entries], "max")
307 |             calc = QgsRasterCalculator(
308 |                 expr,
309 |                 tmp_path,
310 |                 "GTiff",
311 |                 extent,
312 |                 crs,
313 |                 width,
314 |                 height,
315 |                 entries,
316 |                 QgsCoordinateTransformContext()
317 |             )
318 |
